edit.description: extend(base, delta): a new name mints a subkind; relocate is extend under the base's name, one operation; a locus outside the base's refuses
kind-fact row names the subkind's base
reads the base column; unknown base or locus outside it refuses at load
a document in both loci is the subkind's one member, never a governs collision
collision diagnostics stay for unrelated kinds

summary: extend(base, {name, …}) mints a subkind that keeps its base's facts and governs a locus within the base's; a document there is one member of the subkind, never a collision
acceptance: a lock declaring a subkind of rule over a sub-locus reads its documents as subkind members with no governs collision; a subkind locus outside its base's refuses at load
tests: a document in a subkinds locus is one member of the subkind
a document in a subkinds locus raises no governs collision with its base
a subkind whose locus lies outside its bases refuses at load
notes: 0094 Decision. Seam change, two-sided (PROTOCOL 4); builtin_lock.toml carries no subkind, so it is unchanged. Row shape is build's call; the engine must know the base for BASE-SELECTIONS-BIND-A-SUBKIND. Existing relocate callers keep working.
